title: 4 Values whose Sum is 0
description: The SUM problem can be formulated as follows: given four lists A, B, C, D of integer values, compute how many quadruplet (a, b, c, d ) ∈ A x B x C x D are such that a + b + c + d = 0 . In the following, we assume that all lists have the same size n.
inputDesc: The first line of the input contains the size of the lists n (this value can be as large as 4000). We then have n lines containing four integer values (with absolute value as large as 228) that belong respectively to A, B, C and D .
outputDesc: For each input, your program has to write the number quadruplets whose sum is zero.
